## Summary

**What changed:** Concise 1-2 line description of the change.

**Why:** Explain the problem or motivation.

## API or behavior impact

- [ ] No user-facing change
- [ ] User-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Planned public API changed

If behavior or the planned public API changed, mention likely release impact in
the PR description.

## Docs and examples

- [ ] README updated if user-facing API or usage changed
- [ ] PLAN updated if the intended product direction changed
- [ ] Example app updated if the public usage changed
- [ ] No docs or example changes needed

## Pre-submission checklist

- [ ] `fvm flutter analyze` passes
- [ ] `fvm flutter test` passes
- [ ] `fvm dart format .` run
- [ ] Commits follow `type(scope): summary`
- [ ] Commit bodies explain why
- [ ] No unrelated changes mixed in

## Related issues

Closes #[issue number] (if applicable)
